data.title: CML elaborator: Finite fragment to the normalized semantic AST; model types moved to continuum-model-core (bn-ybq)

data.body: [HIGH] Strict-bound overflow admits a state forbidden by CML. domain_of converts v > c with c.saturating_add(1) and v < c with c.saturating_sub(1). For x > i64::MAX && x <= i64::MAX, lines 370 and 367 produce [MAX, MAX]; init x == MAX then lowers successfully although the refinement is unsatisfiable. The kernel sees only the derived domain, so it cannot detect this CML-to-model semantic mismatch. Use checked arithmetic and return a typed empty-domain or refinement error. Add both i64-edge regressions.

[HIGH] A small untrusted model can force multi-gigabyte allocation before rejection. The loop accepts a domain product up to 2^22, then line 257 clones every variable name into every initial-state binding. Twenty-two binary variables with init true create 4,194,304 x 22 owned bindings. ModelBuilder rejects above 2^20 only after all bindings exist at model.rs:853, so the process can OOM first. Bound accumulation before allocation or use a compact streaming builder. Add a memory-bounded adversarial test.

[HIGH] Parsed nesting limits do not bound semantic dependency recursion. alias recursively calls resolve_type at line 336, and a def call recursively enters self.def at line 1189 before copied measures the result. Long acyclic alias or def chains fit under the 16 MiB source limit and can exhaust the Rust stack. A def chain that reduces to one literal never exceeds MAX_INLINE_DEPTH. Resolve dependency graphs iteratively or enforce an explicit chain-depth limit with a typed resource error. Test near and over the limit.

[MEDIUM] Set canonicalization can retain insertion order for distinct outer binders. Mode::SortKey maps every binder outside the element to the same free token. Thus {x, y} and {y, x} inside forall x, y have equal sort keys. Stable sort preserves source order, while final identity later encodes different de Bruijn depths. Equivalent sets can receive different NormIdentity values, breaking the stated set-order and content-identity invariant. Add an alpha-stable tie-break and a bound-variable permutation regression.

[RISK:HIGH] Failure modes: wrong lowered transition system, process OOM or stack abort, and non-canonical identity. Edge cases: i64 strict bounds, 22 binary variables with true init, long acyclic alias or def chains, and sets containing outer binders. Rollback: keep the prior scaffold or revert this commit until fixes receive fresh review. Monitoring: no production path exists yet; before exposure, record typed limit refusals and watch RSS and process aborts. Validation: add focused boundary, adversarial, and metamorphic tests, then run the full locked just check gate. This BLOCK does not satisfy or weaken the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

data.reason: BLOCK: three unresolved HIGH findings allow false CML semantics, memory exhaustion, and stack exhaustion. One MEDIUM finding breaks canonical semantic identity. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.

data.body: Fixed in 687e904. Alias and def orders now come from an explicit-stack search (dependency_order), so each alias or def body is resolved once, callees first. A chain no longer recurses. MAX_INLINE_DEPTH is now 64, so a tree is at most parser nesting plus 64 deep. Recursive frames are split small, and lower refuses deeper expressions before recursing (ExpressionTooDeep). Tests in tests/resource_bounds.rs: 5000-link alias and def chains and cycles, built one line per link. Also inline depth at and one over the limit, and the deepest accepted tree through elaborate, dump, identity and lower. All run in a 512 KiB thread.

Fixed in 687e904. lower counts bindings before it adds each initial state and stops at MAX_INIT_BINDINGS (2^20) with Unlowerable::TooManyInitialStates. Enumeration time stays bounded by MAX_INIT_ENUMERATION. Test a_wide_init_is_refused_within_a_memory_limit runs 22 binary variables with init true in a child under ulimit -v 512 MiB. With the bound removed, that child aborts on allocation (checked).

Fixed in 687e904. Strict bounds use checked_add and checked_sub. Overflow, or lo > hi after combination, is Unlowerable::EmptyRefinement. Regressions: x > i64::MAX && x <= i64::MAX, and x < i64::MIN && x >= i64::MIN, both EmptyRefinement. Crossing bounds are also EmptyRefinement. Satisfiable intervals at both edges lower to exactly [MAX-1, MAX] and [MIN, MIN+1].

Fixed in 687e904. finish keeps the scope of enclosing binders. Set and map literals are sorted and deduplicated by Expr::scoped_key, which writes each bound variable as its de Bruijn depth. The key is alpha-stable, independent of binder numbering, and distinct for distinct variables. The shared-free SortKey mode is removed. Regression: metamorphic.rs::set_insertion_order_of_bound_variables_preserves_identity checks {a,b} = {b,a} = {b,a,b} = alpha-renamed {d,c}, {a,a} different, and permuted map keys.

687e904 addresses all four findings with the boundary and adversarial tests listed in their threads. Full locked just check is green except check_obligations security-review-present, which the lead owns. The dossier traceability staleness comes from the rebase onto other bones and is lead-owned. The risk:critical human-approval gate is unchanged.

[HIGH] Wrapper alias chains still bypass the recursion bound. resolve_aliases orders dependencies iteratively, but alias returns t.clone() at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/elab.rs:378. Each one-level Option, Set, Seq, Map, tuple, record, or function alias can make the cached Type deeper than the parser nesting limit. Derived Clone here, and recursive Unifier::resolve and occurs at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/types.rs:136-163, can overflow the stack before any typed error. Bound resolved type size and depth, and avoid recursive cloning or traversal before that check. Add a 5000-link Option alias chain in the 512 KiB resource-bound harness.

[HIGH] MAX_NODES is checked only after substitution fully materializes its result. call invokes substitute at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/elab.rs:1420, and substitute clones the whole argument for every parameter occurrence at lines 1948-1949. A flat def body with N references and a flat argument with M nodes can allocate N*M nodes while the source and pre-call node count remain below their limits; copied measures the result only afterward at lines 835-839 and 1421. Pre-compute expansion size with checked arithmetic, or clone through a budget that returns TooLarge before allocation. Add a memory-limited repeated-parameter by wide-argument regression.

[HIGH] Boolean lowering can expand a bounded-depth source exponentially before ModelBuilder checks it. bool_expr routes Iff and Boolean Eq through iff at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/lower.rs:542-549, and iff clones both already-lowered operands at lines 582-586. shallow admits a normalized tree through depth 33, so a small nested Iff chain can materialize billions of BoolExpr nodes and exhaust memory. Enforce an output-node budget during conversion, or lower equivalence without duplicating trees. Add an address-space-limited near-bound nested-Iff regression.

[HIGH] The explicit dependency order closes recursive traversal of simple alias and def chains, but the alias fix is incomplete. A chain that wraps each prior alias grows the cached Type depth and recursively clones it at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/elab.rs:378. The new line-378 thread records the remaining stack-exhaustion path.
Verified at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/lower.rs:276-293. The binding counter rejects before the next initial-state allocation, and the adversarial test covers the prior 22-variable path.

data.body: Verified at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/elab.rs:1704-1723 and norm.rs:497-507. Set and map ordering now uses the enclosing de Bruijn scope, and the regression covers permutation and alpha-renaming.

data.body: [RISK:HIGH] Failure modes: stack overflow during alias expansion, allocator exhaustion during def substitution, and allocator exhaustion during Boolean lowering. Edge cases: one-wrapper-per-declaration alias chains, flat repeated parameters with wide arguments, and nested Iff or Boolean Eq near the accepted depth. Rollback: revert or disable the CML elaboration and lowering feature until every intermediate allocation and type traversal is bounded. Monitoring: record typed limit refusals and watch process RSS and aborts before any production exposure. Validation: add small-stack and address-space-limited adversarial regressions for all three paths, then run the full locked gate. This BLOCK does not satisfy or weaken the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

data.reason: Three HIGH untrusted-input resource-exhaustion paths remain: recursive wrapper-alias Type depth, multiplicative def-substitution allocation before MAX_NODES, and exponential Iff lowering before builder validation.

data.body: Fixed in 80f2f7d. Before a type expression is built, its size and depth are computed from the syntax and the cached alias measures. Depth is checked against MAX_TYPE_DEPTH (128) and size is charged to the output budget, so an alias clone is charged before it happens. Every node type is also checked on storage. Unifier::resolve runs only after measure_resolved, an iterative DAG walk with a memo, has bounded depth and charged size. occurs and unify are iterative. Tests: wrapper_alias_depth_is_bounded_near_and_over_the_limit (at the bound, and one over). a_long_wrapper_alias_chain_is_refused_within_limits (5000 Option aliases). an_inferred_type_chain_is_refused_within_limits (5000 binders chained through inference). Adversarial cases run under ulimit -v 512 MiB and a 512 KiB stack.

Fixed in 80f2f7d. call now measures each argument and computes the exact size of the substituted body before substitute runs (measure_with counts an argument once per parameter occurrence). It charges that size to the budget and refuses with TooLarge before anything is copied. Let copies are measured once at the let and charged before each clone. Test def_substitution_is_charged_before_it_is_built: 300 x 300 fits; 4000 references x 4000-element argument is refused in a child under ulimit -v 512 MiB. With the pre-charge removed, that child dies on a failed allocation (checked).

Fixed in 80f2f7d. Lowering takes an output budget. Every lowered node is charged before it is built, with its variable-name text. The expression language has no sharing, so the second copy of each operand of <=>, Boolean ==/!=, Boolean if, and a non-constant range is charged before the clone (copy). A nest is refused as Unlowerable::OutputTooLarge when the next copy does not fit. Test equivalence_lowering_is_charged_before_each_copy: 15 levels lower (near). 22 levels are refused under ulimit -v 512 MiB, for both <=> and ==. With the copy charge removed, the child aborts on allocation (checked).

Round 2 is fixed in 80f2f7d with one structural rule: one output budget is threaded through elaboration, substitution and lowering, and every amplifying allocation is charged before it happens. The site inventory is in the crate docs, section 'Every allocation proportional to input is pre-charged'. just check is green except the lead-owned items: check_obligations security-review-present, and dossier traceability staleness from the rebase. /tmp on this host gave linker bus errors (signal 7) in continuum-context doctests, so I ran the gate with TMPDIR on disk.
